messages:
sasha: quick idea for DP/beta prioritization: offer each partner a small "feature credit" (1-2 priority tokens) they can allocate to product asks. helps us triage roadmap asks vs. platform blockers. thoughts?

michael: interesting. how do credits map to dev effort? we need a table: token -> small (2d), medium (1 sprint), large (multi-sprint).

ana: +1 but require that credits can only be spent on scoped, well-specified asks (PRD + sample prompts). otherwise we get vague asks.

lina: CS ok with that if we also require partners to commit to at least 4 paired-eval cycles and a short case study if the feature ships.

ravi: ops note  some asks impact infra (routing, kv-cache) and will need capacity planning. any token allocation should surface an ops impact tag.

emily: from partner success side, make sure credits avoid heavy legal/priv infra. maybe mark some asks as "opt-in enterprise only" so partners know tradeoffs.

jen: legal: we can do a one-page addendum that covers feature work and IP, but we should cap feature scope for beta to avoid long negotiations.

sasha: proposal: token tiers:
- token A -> quick config change / UI tweak (<=2 dev days)
- token B -> small runtime change or new metric (+1 sprint)
- token C -> non-trivial infra or legal-heavy (requires approval, not part of default credit)
Partners get 2 tokens; can combine tokens for bigger asks but must sign progress gates.

michael: also recommend a "roadmap priority queue": tokenized asks land in a public-but-limited queue. product may implement or convert to backlog item after QA + paired-eval evidence.

ana: success criteria we should record per ask: acceptance test, paired-eval margin, and adoption signal (>= 3 customers using within 30 days).

ravi: blocker: need a quick internal process to estimate token cost/ops impact. i've got a tiny spreadsheet template we can reuse.

emily: blocker: CS bandwidth. we can support feature pairing for up to 4 partners in-parallel. beyond that we need more SE hours.

jen: blocker: feature credits that affect data handling will need the addendum signed first. mark those tokens as contingent.

sasha: operational flow suggestion:
1) partner picks asks and assigns tokens on acceptance
2) partner provides PRD + sample prompts within 72h
3) product + eng triage and tag with token cost + ops risk within 5d
4) we schedule work in a dev window; partner agrees to paired-eval + 30d adoption check

michael: makes sense. can we add a rollback SLA for runtime changes (manual flip + auto-fallback if error spike >5% for 5m)? ravi?

ravi: yes, we can require a canary + rollback plan; default auto-fallback thresholds applied unless partner requests lower.

lina: can we also surface a quick line in invites: "You get 2 feature credits; details in the beta terms" so expectations are set?

emily: agree. incentives: combine credits with product credit payout on successful exit to encourage completion.

sasha: ok owners: michael = feature-credit mechanism + invite wording, ana = acceptance tests + paired-eval rubric, ravi = ops risk template + rollback SLA, jen = addendum template, lina = partner comms + case-study flow.

michael: i'll draft the invite blurb and the token-cost table today.

ana: i'll prep the acceptance-test checklist and example PRD template.

ravi: i'll share ops template and spreadsheet for token estimates.

jen: will draft a one-page addendum for tokenized feature work.

(dp-bot): Ticket created: BETA-777 "feature-credits-dp-prioritization" (assignee: michael).
